title: Disk-lift boundary maps for Serre fibrations with contractible total space
statement: Use the standard topological simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the k-spaces and simplex pairs of [lem-coef-realization-finite-limits], and continuous based homotopy groups as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $p:E\to B$ be continuous and have the right lifting property against $D^m\times\{0\}\hookrightarrow D^m\times[0,1]$ for all $m\geq0$. Fix $e\in E$, put $b=p(e)$, and give $F=p^{-1}(b)$ its k-space fibre topology. For $j\geq0$, let $a:|\Delta^{j+1}|\to B$ be continuous and constant at $b$ on $|\partial\Delta^{j+1}|$. There exists a continuous $g:|\Delta^{j+1}|\to E$ with $pg=a$ and $g=e$ on $|\Lambda_{j+1}^{j+1}|$. For any such lift the last-face restriction $g\circ|d_{j+1}|:|\Delta^j|\to F$ is constant at $e$ on its boundary, and its based homotopy class depends only on the based homotopy class of $a$, not on $g$. For $j=0$ take the path component of the point $g(0)\in F$. This defines natural pointed maps $\delta_j:\pi_{j+1}(B,b)\to\pi_j(F,e)$, with target $\pi_0(F)$ when $j=0$. These are the Serre connecting maps in the last-face convention: use the affine ordered-face parametrization for $d_{j+1}$, and use the same simplex/disk identifications for representatives and their restrictions. In degree zero this is the initial endpoint of a lift with prescribed terminal endpoint $e$, rather than the terminal endpoint of a lift with prescribed initial endpoint. A commutative square of such fibrations preserving the chosen points commutes with these maps. If there is a continuous homotopy $H:E\times[0,1]\to E$ with $H(z,0)=z$, $H(z,1)=e$ and $H(e,t)=e$, then every $\delta_j$ is a bijection of pointed sets, without any connectedness assumption on $B$.
